infoLinks.urlText:
John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is not available

ㅤ
infoLinks.content:
At John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
 
The lift is out of service until further notice while replacement works are carried out.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to
  • Or use the lift on the opposite side of the stop, closest to Harris Street
  • If both lifts are unavailable, the nearest accessible stops are Bank Street (towards Dulwich Hill) and The Star (towards Central)
  • Please allow extra travel time and plan ahead, using the Trip Planner and checking travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
 
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500
